summary: Two complete internally consistent current final rows; no joint target pass; one Train text parsing exception and explicit local/semantic evidence limits.

findings.title: One Train152 label violates the claimed uniform first-four-attributes convention
findings.details: pine02_wild_320 has category pine needles and a single attribute slot containing five semicolon-separated clauses. The training preparer splits only |; the external preparer splits |, ; and full-width semicolon and retains four attributes. 151/152 training rows match that latter convention; 1/152 does not. Both R0 arms pin the same existing training-label hash, so this does not mix conditions or erase the observed results. A strict claim that all train/external inputs used identical first-four-attribute parsing is false. The semantic/empirical effect is unmeasured.
findings.action: Document the historical exception and the actual parser in method/provenance records. Keep existing finals/results immutable. Do not claim a corrected protocol was used without separately running it.

findings.title: The local audit cannot independently recompute metrics from raw trajectories and GT
findings.details: The snapshot contains four OPE metrics/receipts and two VOT analysis/merge/outcome sets, but none of the expected 520 OPE prediction TXT/score files or 10590 VOT bin/confidence/time files. Dataset groundtruth.txt and full RGB/depth streams, native/CLIP checkpoint bytes, and the actual train/external bank tensors are absent from the audited material. The scoped project raw-file search found no matching GT, VOT .bin, OPE score, native/CLIP checkpoint, or human_text.pt files. The generated current VOT plan/execution/wrapper/registry bytes are not in the manifest, although their hashes/creation code are present. Historical official toolkit source is locally readable, but its equality to the actual installed evaluation environment is not independently attested here.
findings.action: Describe this as source/receipt/manifest/numerical correspondence verification. Preserve remote raw artifacts. A future empirical recomputation would require the actual prediction and GT bytes; none was performed here.

findings.title: Human text uses multiframe review; the three test datasets are not disjoint evidence
findings.details: The external text annotations were confirmed with multiframe/video aids, then frozen as initialization text. This is a disclosed human-provided-input protocol, not pure first-frame automatic captioning and not human evaluation of tracker outputs. There are 1895 dataset-prefixed keys but 1859 distinct recorded RGB+box observation keys: 36 shared initialization groups are DepthTrack Test/VOT. Dataset prefixes correctly preserve separate annotations, but the three benchmark results must not be presented as statistically independent unseen datasets.
findings.action: Disclose the human review exposure and exact overlap. Keep real_gt scoring classification separate from text-input provenance.

findings.title: Completed R0 does not meet the nine-metric goal or establish language/C/generalization claims
findings.details: This is two loss-weight conditions with one seed 2027, one fixed third-pass decoder final each, shared human-text protocol and frozen STTrack/CLIP. P0 passes 2/9 gates; P1 passes 3/9; neither jointly passes. No completed current-final empty/generic/shuffled-language interventions, no replicated-seed uncertainty, and no trained C/current-vs-future W/K comparison are in this R0 evidence. Current quality predicts GT-based localization IoU; observation predicts GT-box/window intersection, not physical identity or phrase visibility. selected_feature is recorded; native same-position confidence at interval 50 / threshold 0.75 still controls template writes.
findings.action: Accept only the two completed protocol-qualified rows. Do not promote R0 to goal complete, independent language benefit, an effective new memory module, or universal generalization.

findings.title: Tracker/master completion status lags the sealed result snapshot
findings.details: The audited EXPERIMENT_TRACKER R0 row remains RUNNING with an old observation; the master ends at section 5.434 with P1/formal sealing still pending. The latest primary snapshot has six complete evaluations and a completed recovery controller. This is stale documentation, not missing numerical results. The all_results independent_completed_audit=false field is also pre-audit state and must not be silently changed during this read-only review.
findings.action: After consuming this audit, append an explicit R0 completion record with the unchanged metrics, both joint_pass=false values, and this provisional verdict. Do not mark R1-R5 complete.

A_ground_truth_provenance.details: Dataset-provided boxes drive formal scoring. Train152 GT is loaded by hashed dataset files and consumed after actor.step for loss; invalid GT skips supervision but not history. Current inference entry uses only legal initialization boxes plus RGB-D/text and has no later-GT argument. Native gt_score_map is explicitly None in the active network path. Native predicted boxes/responses form auxiliary preservation teachers, not benchmark GT. Human text protocol and the one-row parsing exception require N1/N3 qualifiers; raw GT/image provenance cannot be independently re-hashed (N2).

B_score_normalization.details: No reported benchmark score is divided by its own maximum/minimum/mean. OPE threshold selection uses predicted confidences, precision divides summed IoU by selected prediction count, recall divides by dataset-visible count, then macro averages curves and reports P/R at the maximum F threshold. Confidence thresholds are standard PR operating points, not self-score normalization. VOT denominators derive from sequence/run lengths and valid progress; percent conversion is exactly x100. Stored EAO curve average and outcome-derived ROB agree numerically with official outputs. These are arithmetic checks on sealed data, not new overlap computation.

C_result_existence_and_correspondence.details: All 183 manifest inputs exist and match exact byte counts/SHA256; both physical final files match. All six metrics, wrappers, CSV rows, gates, 52 source hashes, training pair/result/logs and 116 snapshot digests correspond. Recorded original failed analyses and all successful terminal exits are preserved; no OPE prediction/training restart appears in the recovery source/stages. 111 deterministic checks: 110 true, 1 actual train/external parsing-convention mismatch. Numerical/raw-computation assurance and stale tracker limits remain N2/N5.

D_dead_code.details: Active OPE entry actually calls evaluate_depthtrack_results and emits the metrics consumed by collection; original failed and later successful analysis logs exist. Recovery invokes official VOT analysis, then analyze_m122_vot calls collect_confirmed_failure_outcomes and emits both 1765-outcome dictionaries. The historical low22 main/gate and historical training evaluators are not R0 metric paths; their old targets/numbers are not substituted. The format_metrics helper and imported historical eval helpers are unused in the R0 entry but are not sources of claimed current metrics. No uncalled active metric was found.

E_scope.details: Each condition trains its 380167-parameter decoder on 3 x 152 complete sequence passes, 659406 track calls, 610128 valid supervised frames, 20421 updates; native/CLIP frozen. Each fixed final evaluates Test50/76373 frames, CDTB80/101956 frames, VOT127/1765 anchors. Single seed; no final selection by public metric. Training sparse traces are 1998 rows per arm and not complete frozen-final trajectories. No current evidence establishes language-content gain, C utility, independent identity/visibility truth, crop-external recovery or multiseed generalization. N1-N5 constrain claims.

F_evaluation_type.details: All six current formal evaluations are real_gt with human-confirmed frozen initialization text. Human input annotation is not human_eval performance scoring. Sanity comparisons to native predicted trajectories are explicitly numerical equivalence/self_supervised_proxy checks, not current tracking accuracy. Old M107 model-weak labels are synthetic_proxy auxiliaries outside R0; no synthetic/proxy/historical score replaces a final benchmark result.
